title: hydrocotyle umbellata var. bonariensis
intro: Hydrocotyle umbellata var. bonariensis, commonly known as Pennywort or Gotu Kola, is a plant species that belongs to the family Araliaceae. It is valued for its potential health benefits, which include reducing stress and anxiety, improving cognitive function, and supporting skin health due to its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system, improve memory and cognitive function, and exert anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects. The bioactive constituents of Pennywort include flavonoids, alkaloids, and triterpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
